name: 旧古井家住宅
checkpoints: ONE low single-storey farmhouse under a thick thatched hip-and-gable roof with visible upper triangular gable and timber ridge hold-downs.
Ochre earthen walls, modest irregular front openings and timber sliding shutters; preserve the asymmetry of the actual façade, not a temple layout.
Exclude the neighboring modern house, paving, signs, trees and lawn.
